Edward Jones reported advertising expense of $39 million in the first quarter of 2025.

Edward Jones defines net new households as new client households opened less client households closed during the period, rounded to the nearest thousand, and notes the metric is estimated based on available information.
items.quote: Net new households represents new client households opened less client households closed during the period, rounded to the nearest thousand. The metric is estimated based on available information.

items.text: Edward Jones states its initiatives include targeting new clients through High Net Worth (attracting and serving high net worth clients), Workplace (connecting local business owners and their employees with financial solutions), and a new digital platform focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.
items.quote: These initiatives also include targeting new clients: High Net Worth, focused on attracting and serving high net worth clients through expanded advice, planning, products and services across multiple service models; Workplace, which connects local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace; and a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.

cells.reason: Passages disclose EDJ's advertising expense (a component of client-acquisition cost), its net-new-households client-acquisition metric, and its new-client initiatives, but no cost-per-acquisition figure or comparison to Schwab's scale advantages is stated.
